تخترعين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِعِينَ (taḵtariʕīna) /tax.ta.ri.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# تُخْتَرَعِينَ (tuḵtaraʕīna) /tux.ta.ra.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
